name: aurora-text
title: Aurora Text
description: Four-colour gradient text whose colours drift slowly through the letters, magenta to violet to blue to cyan by default, set after a plain lead-in word.
useWhen: One emphasised word in a headline should glow with a slowly drifting aurora of colour.
A hero line needs a soft, premium colour movement without any entrance animation.
avoidWhen: The colour should flow quickly in two tones: use animated-gradient-text.
The gradient should sweep once across the text: use text-shimmer.
author: Magic UI

variables.label: Lead-in
variables.description: Plain text before the aurora word. Leave empty to show only the aurora word.

variables.label: Aurora text
variables.description: The word or phrase filled with the drifting gradient.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Colour 1
variables.description: First gradient colour (also closes the loop).

variables.label: Lead-in colour
variables.description: Colour of the plain lead-in text.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: The drift takes 10 / speed seconds for one pass (source default speed 1 takes 10 s, so 2 fits the block).
